description: Cross-sections of the client's pending absorbers reduced from ExoMol line lists (rendering plan R08, R08.T4.c; decision-r08-t4b-t12c.md, follow-ups 3 and 4): per species or pair and task, its 1 nm cell-mean cross-sections over 380-760 nm at its source's temperature nodes: cellMeansM2, m2 a molecule, or cellMeansM5, m5 a molecule pair, one row of 381 cells a node, the cells centred on 380, 381, ..., 760 nm, each [nm - 0.5, nm + 0.5) on vacuum wavelengths, rounded up to 3 significant figures so that each stays a bound. Adapted material of the ExoMol database, offered under CC BY-SA 4.0 (README.md beside this file, and NOTICE).

bounds.source: ExoMol line list C2018 for 14NH3 (P. A. Coles, R. I. Ovsyannikov, O. L. Polyansky, S. N. Yurchenko and J. Tennyson, J. Quant. Spectrosc. Radiat. Transfer 219 (2018) 199-212, DOI 10.1016/j.jqsrt.2018.07.022), https://www.exomol.com/db/NH3/14N-1H3/C2018/; def.json SHA-256 f8ce0d6176baf7f4d585b30a19c4a4ec6515def26d902c1da8d2f73a2ac7bba0, states.bz2 58af64e31a8de20d7b99fe685d7bbb12f06d51a34580e5ba4dc9e8030934147a and the 7 transition files of 13000-20000 cm-1; fetched 2026-10-11
bounds.method: Direct sum over C2018's 243.7 million lines of 13149-20000 cm-1 with its own partition sum (Q296 1725.29, HITRAN's TIPS 1725.2); each 1 nm vacuum cell's mean over 380-760 nm at each node. The 5-quantum NH-stretch band near 645 nm sets it ((4,0,1,0) 83%); its 552 nm band peaks at 3.18e-29 m2 at 296 K. HITRAN2024's NH3 lines end at 12810 cm-1 (780.6 nm), and CoYuTe at 20000 cm-1 for 14NH3; C2018 is valid to 300 K.

bounds.source: ExoMol line list TYM v20240527 (S. N. Yurchenko, T. M. Mellor and J. Tennyson, MNRAS 534 (2024) 1364, DOI 10.1093/mnras/stae2201) (via https://www.exomol.com, the cross-section service https://www.exomol.com/xsec/14N2-16O/, Doppler profiles, 1 cm-1 bins over 13100-19999 cm-1); .sigma SHA-256 296 K 0ccb99a743877d030da7057813626e1429d4475b29c67485024882fca3d9ad42; fetched 2026-10-10
bounds.method: TYM's lines that R08.T4.d's HITRAN2024 table does not draw (R08.T4.g, split from R08.T4.d; decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md section 11, ruling 3), from R08.T4.f's TYM entry's 296 K cell means: each 1 cm-1 bin of the service's cross-sections in the cell holding its centre, each 1 nm vacuum cell's mean. Over 380-712 nm, TYM's cell means, N2O's lines below HITRAN2024's 713.4 nm; TYM ends at 20000 cm-1, so the cells below 500 nm are 0. The largest is 669 nm (1.29e-32 m2); at the helium Rayleigh cap the cells reach tau 72 (706 nm) and 64 (669 nm), 0.48 at 600 nm, so the species stays pending rather than dropped. From 714 nm, TYM's excess over R08.T4.c's HITRAN2024 cell means, cell by cell, HITRAN's rounding up taken off it so that each stays a bound: TYM's bands that HITRAN2024 lacks, and TYM's excess within HITRAN's own, at most 1.46e-32 m2 (752 nm). The 713 nm cell takes 1.29e-32 m2, the bound R08.T4.c recorded for TYM's part of any cell below 713.4 nm (at most 1.28e-32), plus its excess there. Every value rounded up to 3 significant figures.

bounds.source: ExoMol line list Li2015 v20170101 (G. Li et al., ApJS 216 (2015) 15, DOI 10.1088/0067-0049/216/1/15; dataset DOI 10.5281/zenodo.5716770) (via https://www.exomol.com, https://www.exomol.com/db/CO/12C-16O/Li2015/); trans.bz2 SHA-256 20a9aa869fdede362300a26f818bad21130f1f2b73f477d38b2d39d8bb361410, states.bz2 83ca303698873576e985482227c33a7b93f119c5bb200f9e7e542273eb6804e1, .pf 0a6c56318875a4cf6bfc7f8aa9b5609865025c922bf0ccf42f6b017c1ed29b43; fetched 2026-10-11
bounds.method: Direct sum with every transition of v' - v'' >= 8 dropped (23837 dropped, 1107 kept in range; decision-r08-t4b-t12c.md follow-up 3: Li2015's 9-0 is stronger than its 8-0 and 7-0, breaking the ladder's decline), scaled by 2.13, the ratio of HITRAN2024's measurement-anchored 7-0 peak cell to Li2015's at 296 K (5.096e-34 against 2.397e-34 m2); each 1 nm vacuum cell's mean over 380-760 nm at each node. Unscaled: 2.020e-34, 1.200e-34, 6.636e-34 and 2.321e-33 m2. 1000-2000 K: the 7-0 band; 3000-4000 K: the hot Delta v = 7 bands (11-4 to 14-7, Li2015's calculation) near 758 nm.

bounds.method: Direct sum over the 7608 F-X transitions in range; each 1 nm vacuum cell's mean over 380-760 nm at each node. The list stops at v' = 4, so it covers 651-760 nm: the F4Delta-X4Delta (3,0), (4,0), (4,1), (2,0) and (3,1) bands.
